note: Statuses are TO_AUDIT placeholders only, not actual implementation state. Respect repo owner approvals.

tasks.title: Audit actual integration baseline
tasks.objective: Choose a source-of-truth integration SHA without assuming that main or the old tracker reflects all completed work.
acceptance_criteria: Record current main, RC branch, candidate PRs, heads, merged/unmerged status and potential conflicts.
Compare actual code and fresh tests with docs/TIEN_DO.md and docs/KIEM_THU.md.
Publish a verified status table; never mark manual/LAN tasks PASS based on automated loopback tests.
verification: Repository/PR audit signed off by A and C.
Clean build on the selected candidate baseline, with exact SHA and environment.
tasks.risk_or_note: Existing 17-Oct report is historical evidence, not proof of current HEAD.

tasks.title: Close Phase 3 review and integration gaps
tasks.objective: Reconcile Listening, autosave/submit, delta hooks, server state, installer and release branch.
acceptance_criteria: Review the Phase 3 implementation against 02_HOP_DONG.md, especially Listening no-replay, auth-before-cache and ACK-after-commit.
Write a human-reviewed integration matrix and unresolved issues.
Do not rebuild Phase 3 tasks whose code already exists.
verification: Clean Java package tests with PostgreSQL where required.
Manual hearing, packaged JavaFX and LAN checks remain NOT RUN until performed.

tasks.title: Delta correctness go/no-go
tasks.objective: Make an evidence-backed decision about experimental DELTA; preserve FULL as the operational fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Use the pre-existing 20-Oct gate for MT02-MT06 and live disconnect/rejoin conditions.
If incomplete, incorrect or unreviewed: FULL remains the default; publish failure or missing evidence.
Do not claim E2 performance until correctness and measurement prerequisites are met.
verification: Oracle replay vs FULL, epoch/reconnect/retry and human reviewer notes.
Update gate status explicitly: PASS, FAIL or NOT_DECIDED.
tasks.risk_or_note: Never silently turn DELTA on in production.

tasks.title: Approve new scope and contract amendments
tasks.objective: Document requested expanded exam media and multi-signal monitoring before interface-changing work.
acceptance_criteria: Propose amendments to CLAUDE.md, 02_HOP_DONG.md, docs/PROTOCOL.md and testing docs; original lecturer sources stay unchanged.
Explicitly remove only the existing USB out-of-scope restriction after owner approval.
Record data minimization, consent/notice, capture lifetime, media copyright and retention assumptions.
Resolve or flag the QD-21 deadline/start-gate conflict; do not silently change deadline semantics.
verification: A and C approve the delta; B reviews the affected client contract.
New message types, API DTO and migrations are versioned and regression-tested.
tasks.risk_or_note: This ZIP is a proposal, not an automatic override of the current contract.

tasks.title: Audit one legitimate 200-question TOEIC dataset
tasks.objective: Identify one complete 7-Part exam and verify all source materials before coding large-scale imports.
acceptance_criteria: Count 6/25/39/30/30/16/54 questions in Parts 1-7, respectively.
Inventory audio, images, passages, groups, original answer options and correct answer keys.
Report missing items honestly; separate remote media URLs from files already downloaded.
Identify the license/permission status before distributing third-party material.
verification: Produce manifest with original source, SHA-256 where local, missing-file flags and zero invented answer data.
Content review by A/B.
likely_scope: Offline input HTML/JSON, media manifest, dataset-audit report
tasks.risk_or_note: The plan package includes no copyrighted exams or media.

tasks.title: Define rich exam import and render contract
tasks.objective: Extend the existing exam DTO only as needed for grouped passages, images and legitimate audio-based choices.
acceptance_criteria: Support question order, 7 Parts, groupId, reusable audio, zero-or-more ordered content blocks and per-question options.
Allow Part 1/2 letter choices when transcripts are not available; do not fabricate dialogue/transcripts.
Correct options remain server-only; authorized candidate DTO never exposes answer key.
Keep compatibility with existing text/audio JSON if possible.
verification: Schema/DTO fixtures including Part 1 photo, Part 3 shared audio, Part 6 passage and Part 7 multi-document.
Negative validator fixtures.
likely_scope: protocol exam DTOs, import contracts, docs/PROTOCOL.md

tasks.title: Build offline parser, validator and repeatable seed
tasks.objective: Transform permitted content into validated imports; seed once and create multiple sessions from the existing exam.
acceptance_criteria: Validator enforces 200 unique ordered questions and expected Part distribution.
Every referenced audio/image exists, has an allowed format and passes SHA-256 before release.
No duplicate group mismatch, missing correct option or broken passage links.
Importer is deterministic and refuses a conflicting duplicate examId rather than silently overwriting.
verification: Valid fixture succeeds; incomplete/corrupt/mismatched fixtures are rejected with exact reasons.
Database import + retrieval round trip on test PostgreSQL.
likely_scope: Offline tooling (Java by default), import/seed adapter, local dataset report
tasks.risk_or_note: CLAUDE.md currently limits Python to CSV/plots. Do not introduce a Python HTML parser unless the owner explicitly amends that rule.

tasks.title: Add image metadata and ordered rich-content storage
tasks.objective: Add minimum Flyway migration and filesystem configuration for exam images and content blocks.
acceptance_criteria: Check the latest existing Flyway version before naming a new migration; never edit applied V1..Vn.
Keep structured metadata in PostgreSQL; media binaries remain outside the DB/JAR.
Store relative paths, MIME, content length, SHA-256, ordering and question/group association.
Do not break the established TOEIC_AUDIO_ROOT manifest/READY semantics.
verification: Fresh database migration test and upgrade test from the current release schema.
Reject invalid file paths and dangling asset references.

tasks.title: Authenticated image delivery and media validation
tasks.objective: Allow authorized candidates/proctors to retrieve referenced image assets without expanding the audio protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Check user role, assignment and attempt scope before returning bytes or cache metadata.
Prevent ../ traversal, escaping symlinks, unexpected MIME and oversized files.
Support predictable checksum and cache behavior; no answer key in image endpoint metadata.
Keep the existing audio manifest, READY and start semantics intact.
verification: Real HTTP auth tests for owner vs other attempt, missing/changed asset, traversal and checksums.
Manual client downloads with filenames containing spaces/Unicode.
likely_scope: server exam media controller/service, protocol DTOs, media config

tasks.title: Render real seven-Part content in JavaFX
tasks.objective: Display text, images and grouping as the TOEIC exam actually requires.
acceptance_criteria: Correctly render Part 1 photos; Part 3/4 shared audio and optional figures; Part 6/7 passage layouts and multiple content blocks.
Part 1/2 option labels work even without transcript text.
Network/download and decoding stay off JavaFX Application Thread; failed images show an honest retry/error state.
Image navigation does not restart Listening or lose unsaved answers.
verification: GUI fixture tests for every Part and media errors.
Packaged JavaFX smoke with actual image/audio.
likely_scope: client exam views, styling, media client, UI tests

tasks.title: Proctor exam catalog and authoritative start gate
tasks.objective: Let a proctor select a stored exam and start a scheduled session without granting premature answer access.
acceptance_criteria: Provide an authenticated exam catalog with metadata only; preserve existing import/session compatibility.
An attempt may be ACTIVE for monitoring and READY while its session is SCHEDULED; GET questions, submit and save must be gated by authoritative server rules.
Preserve allowed pre-start manifest/download/checksum and READY flows.
Resolve server deadline policy explicitly against QD-21; retries/takeover cannot reset or prolong an existing deadline.
verification: PG/HTTP tests before START and after START for questions, save and submit.
RBAC and READY/Listening start idempotency/reconnect regression.
likely_scope: server ExamService/controllers, client proctor exam picker, contract documentation
tasks.risk_or_note: Backend gate is mandatory; disabling UI controls is not a security boundary.

tasks.title: End-to-end real 200-question acceptance
tasks.objective: Prove one complete exam works from proctor selection to final score.
acceptance_criteria: Proctor selects approved stored exam, assigns candidates, confirms READY and starts it.
Candidate navigates all Parts with real media, autosaves, submits or times out.
Correct-answer keys never leak into candidate DTO and final score is computed by the server.
Listening interruption, stale save, deadline and writer takeover remain correct.
verification: Real PostgreSQL end-to-end evidence for 200 questions.
Packaged Windows app smoke and checksum manifest for all media.

tasks.title: JavaFX design system
tasks.objective: Create a coherent lightweight JavaFX style without changing the UI stack.
acceptance_criteria: Define reusable CSS tokens, text hierarchy, spacing, buttons, badges, tables, hover/focus and disabled states.
Preserve accessibility and contrast; do not hide network failure or data-stale status.
No HTML/WebView replacement or framework migration.
verification: Visual before/after screenshots and UI smoke.
No change in server or monitoring contract.

tasks.title: Polish candidate exam interaction
tasks.objective: Make the 200-question exam easy to complete under exam constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Responsive panes for passage/image and answer area; clear question palette and answered counts.
Timer, save ACK, offline/stale and navigation status unambiguous.
No automatic playback or model reset on view reflow.
verification: UI smoke at different window sizes, 200-question navigation and media stress.
Regression save/submit and Listening behavior.

tasks.title: Polish Listening preparation and interruption UI
tasks.objective: Show media readiness and Listening lifecycle clearly without altering authority.
acceptance_criteria: Download/checksum/speaker test and READY feedback have proper progress/error states.
START received only through valid server command; interrupted Listening visibly remains locked.
No duplicate start, replay or silent auto-resume.
verification: LT01-LT04 targeted regression and packaged hearing test.

tasks.title: Polish proctor roster, control and exam selection
tasks.objective: Improve proctor readability and safe action affordances.
acceptance_criteria: Clear session state, candidate roster, readiness, exam catalog, starts, results and pending actions.
Distinguish loading/stale/disconnected from success, especially after lost HTTP response.
Retain server-side authorization and pending-request semantics.
verification: GUI smoke with 2 candidate records and explicit wrong-role cases.
Compare rendered state after reconnect.

tasks.title: GUI responsiveness and packaging regression
tasks.objective: Protect the functioning JavaFX application from regressions due to polish.
acceptance_criteria: No file, HTTP, process scan or USB probing on JavaFX Application Thread.
Workers stop on logout/exit; stale callbacks cannot overwrite a newly selected attempt.
Installer/app-image runs without IDE and with Unicode paths.
verification: UI interaction and worker cleanup tests.
Packaged smoke and evidence on intended OS.

tasks.title: Prove existing process monitoring end to end
tasks.objective: Treat existing ProcessCollector and FULL monitoring as reusable infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate-only collector observes allowlisted apps and sends event/state to server.
Proctor sees correct attempt event/state; no proctor collector, no duplicate event per scan.
Missing metadata and absence of events do not become false cheating conclusions.
verification: MT01/MT07/MT08 technical regression and a manual LAN observation.
Store observed/received times separately.
likely_scope: client monitoring, server monitoring, proctor view

tasks.title: Windows USB-storage presence and plug/unplug events
tasks.objective: Monitor actual USB mass-storage presence and changes during an authorized exam.
acceptance_criteria: Compare Windows PnP notification with a documented, bounded WMI/CIM fallback; choose one justified by hardware evidence.
Emit PRESENT_AT_START, CONNECTED and REMOVED only for classified storage, not every USB mouse/keyboard.
Debounce duplicate OS notifications; report unknown classification rather than inventing device identity.
No reading files, serial numbers in ordinary logs, hidden monitoring or OS-level blocking.
verification: Use a physical storage USB on Windows: baseline, plug, unplug, fast duplicate, reconnect and process restart.
Test no-admin deployment and explicit unsupported-device statuses.
likely_scope: client monitoring/windows USB observer; integration via MON-07
tasks.risk_or_note: Native dependencies such as JNA need README declaration and packaging test; no hardware equals NOT RUN, not PASS.

tasks.title: Candidate exam focus monitoring
tasks.objective: Observe candidate window focus changes only during an authorized attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Emit focus lost/restored with monotonic in-client duration if measurable.
Account for legitimate JavaFX internal dialogs and startup transitions.
Avoid global window-title scraping or reading contents of other applications.
verification: JavaFX automated event tests and manual alt-tab/outside-window demo.
No events from proctor role or after session ends.
likely_scope: client exam view/observer, MON-07 event adapter

tasks.title: Minimize and fullscreen-state monitoring
tasks.objective: Track window minimize and exit from fullscreen without requiring kiosk/OS lockdown.
acceptance_criteria: Emit minimize/restore and fullscreen-exit only when applicable to the current window mode.
Debounce duplicate property transitions and distinguish intentional non-fullscreen initial state.
No automatic punishment or forced focus to hide the event.
verification: JavaFX lifecycle and manual window actions, including closing/disposal.
likely_scope: client JavaFX stage observer, MON-07 event adapter

tasks.title: Connected-display count and changes
tasks.objective: Report baseline display count and changes visible to the client OS.
acceptance_criteria: Record reported count at monitoring start and detected change during the attempt.
Use a bounded interval/event-driven refresh and clean resource lifecycle.
Unknown/unsupported changes must be labeled, not treated as proof of one-display use.
verification: Physical connect/disconnect of second display where hardware permits.
Mock JavaFX screen data tested separately, labeled MOCK.
likely_scope: client display observer, MON-07 event adapter

tasks.title: Exam-local activity and idle metrics
tasks.objective: Capture minimal actions inside the exam application only.
acceptance_criteria: Aggregate question navigations/answer actions and elapsed no-interaction time.
Do not record keystrokes, clipboard contents, browser URL, chat messages or private files.
Configurable thresholds do not label the student guilty.
verification: Fixture tests for idle thresholds and no-data/clock gaps.
Verify metrics stop after session ends.
likely_scope: client exam activity observer, MON-07 events

tasks.title: Typed multi-signal event protocol and persistence
tasks.objective: Add a single typed event stream for USB/window/display/activity observations while preserving existing process state semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Document schema version, eventType, eventId, attemptId, client-observed time, server-received time, metadata limits and source.
Check authentication and attempt ownership before duplicate/cached response; no cross-attempt information leakage.
Bound the queue and retries; stable eventId across retries, dedup in DB, ACK success only after commit.
Process current FULL/DELTA state remains distinct from history; do not reuse PROCESS_OBSERVED schema for unrelated signals.
verification: Real PostgreSQL/HTTP/WS tests: accepted, duplicate same/different, malformed, expired session, unauthorized, COMMIT failure.
Simulated ACK loss + actual reconnect and persisted history checks.
likely_scope: protocol, server monitoring handler/persistence, client event delivery
tasks.risk_or_note: Do not refactor the existing reliable process pipeline until equivalence is proven.

tasks.title: Rule-based alert classification
tasks.objective: Group observations into actionable, explainable proctor notices.
acceptance_criteria: Use explicit rules with INFO/REVIEW/HIGH_ATTENTION, configured per approved policy.
Aggregate duplicate and burst events without deleting raw history.
USB or focus event alone never triggers an automatic cheating verdict or exam cancellation.
verification: Deterministic rules tests, thresholds/burst fixtures and harmless false-positive examples.
likely_scope: server monitoring alert summary, client proctor display

tasks.title: Unified multi-signal proctor timeline
tasks.objective: Let a proctor inspect an authorized candidate exam through a single reliable event timeline.
acceptance_criteria: Show process, USB, focus, minimize/fullscreen, display, heartbeat/session and Listening interruption from authoritative sources.
Sort/label client observed versus server received time; show stale/UNKNOWN and detection limitations.
Scoped history retrieval and reconnect refresh work; filtering must not make unobserved periods look healthy.
verification: GUI session with two candidate attempts and wrong-role/other-attempt restrictions.
Network reconnect and stale data UX regression.

tasks.title: Full functional and contract regression
tasks.objective: Validate all user-facing paths and the network invariants of the integrated release candidate.
acceptance_criteria: AT01-AT11, LT01-LT04, MT01-MT08 and IT01-IT04 handled according to their specified coverage.
Include new image/media, USB, focus/display and start-gate cases.
Capture actual failures and skipped cases by ID, SHA, OS, environment and input.
verification: Clean Maven test/package with real PostgreSQL where required.
Report PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT RUN without promotion based on mocks.

tasks.title: Multi-client physical LAN acceptance
tasks.objective: Demonstrate real network behavior, not multiple windows on one host.
acceptance_criteria: One server/database and at least two candidate apps plus a proctor across at least two physical machines.
Test correct scoped proctor view, concurrent saving, client disconnect and independent clients.
Listening disconnect preserves no-auto-replay rule; monitoring reconnect reopens fresh FULL.
verification: Record topology, addresses excluding secrets, SHA, OS, steps, logs and screenshots.
Mark BLOCKED/NOT RUN if the second physical machine cannot be arranged.

tasks.title: Fault injection and concurrency consistency
tasks.objective: Prove the server remains correct under duplicate, stale, malformed and concurrent requests.
acceptance_criteria: Test save-vs-submit-vs-timeout and writer takeover with PostgreSQL locks and deterministic barriers.
Test loss of ACK, server restart, stale epoch and wrong-attempt data; malformed requests cannot take down other clients.
Do not return success on DB rollback or return another users private exam data.
verification: Recorded deterministic steps, SQL state and reproducible logs.
Review end state and regression against known passing SHA.

tasks.title: Physical multi-signal acceptance
tasks.objective: Validate physical USB/display plus focus and session lifecycle through the real event path.
acceptance_criteria: Storage USB present-before-start/plug/unplug/duplicate works with real Windows hardware.
Focus/fullscreen/minimize/display events are attributed to correct attempt and timeline.
Reconnect retains committed history, and a stopped attempt has no active observers.
verification: Hardware inventory and permissions, SHA, Windows edition, timestamps, DB rows and proctor screenshots.
Mock tests are supplemental, not proof of physical USB behavior.

tasks.title: E1 controlled polling trade-off experiment
tasks.objective: Measure ProcessHandle polling trade-offs using controlled process ground truth.
acceptance_criteria: Poll periods 250/500/1000/2000 ms, repeated campaign as prescribed in 03_KIEM_THU_VA_THUC_NGHIEM.md.
Record actual observation/miss/detection latency, CPU coverage and memory definition.
Preserve original raw files/checksums and clearly separate historical from newly rerun data.
verification: Analyzer reproduces summary from raw and source SHA.
Invalid/partial runs remain visible and are excluded by written rules.

tasks.title: E2 conditional delta and concurrent-client benchmarks
tasks.objective: Provide defensible network/performance evidence independent of GUI polish.
acceptance_criteria: Run 1/5/10 headless-client load testing as supported by hardware and the existing plan, with repeats and resource metrics.
Run FULL-vs-DELTA E2 only when correctness gate and equivalent measurement inputs/coverage are achieved.
If E2 is blocked, report the reason and use FULL benchmark evidence; do not invent percentage savings.
Distinguish serialized application payload bytes from total TCP/IP wire bytes and headless clients from real JavaFX desktops.
verification: Versioned raw metrics, test configuration, independent analyzer and peer review.
Negative or inconclusive results are documented.
tasks.risk_or_note: E2 is conditional even though concurrency measurement remains a required release activity.

tasks.title: Technical paper-style report
tasks.objective: Write a technically defensible paper, not just user instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Include problem, objectives, architecture, protocol, concurrent requests, persistence, failure handling and implementation.
Clearly separate Spring/JavaFX/DB framework behavior from logic authored by the group.
Explain full 200-question workflows and multi-signal observer sources with limitations.
verification: A/B/C technical cross-review; relevant source/evidence links and references.
Report draft builds and has consistent terminology.
likely_scope: report/ (in actual repo after approval), diagrams, references

tasks.title: Results, discussion, novelty and limitations
tasks.objective: Tie every performance and reliability claim to measured runs or explicit negative results.
acceptance_criteria: Results use valid real metrics with test topology, run count, SHA, environment and confidence limits.
Novelty discusses dependable exam event delivery plus polling and delta only to the extent supported by evidence.
Explicitly document blind spots: process polling miss, client tampering, USB coverage, lack of webcam and monitoring consent.
Do not imply an E2 improvement when it was not run or was inconclusive.
verification: All tables/plots are generated from immutable raw files.
Peer review cross-checks at least one metric by hand.

tasks.title: Repeatable deployment and source packaging
tasks.objective: Deliver an installable/runnable submission containing all legally distributable dependencies and media.
acceptance_criteria: Windows JavaFX client with documented Java runtime, Spring server, PostgreSQL migration and seed data.
TOEIC_AUDIO_ROOT/image root and URLs are configurable and do not assume localhost.
Clean machine startup, import/seed, login, exam, monitoring, exit/uninstall and no-secret packaging documented.
Do not include copyrighted content without distribution rights.
verification: Cold build and clean Windows installation with hashes/screenshots.
README has one path to build, run and test.
likely_scope: README.md proposed update, scripts/installer, config examples, release artifact

tasks.title: Final demo, paper check and submission
tasks.objective: Hand in a credible runnable project before the lecturer deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Prepare one full-exam and multi-signal LAN demonstration with visible event/reconnect/USB behavior.
Run Compilatio and meet course similarity policy; final report version matches handed-over source.
Package NhomXX_TenProject_Source and NhomXX_TenProject_Report.docx in the required Source/Report tree.
Obtain handover acknowledgment; 31-Oct 23:59 ICT is a hard stop, 30-Oct is internal target.
verification: Final signoff checklist and source/report artifact hashes.
Document any incomplete gate honestly.
